text:
rebecca: Postmortem follow-up from 2026-03-17 outage (p95 & throughput regressions). Short thread to lock owners and SLO next-steps.

ishaan: TL;DR: autoscaler hiccup + cross-zone cache churn caused repeated p95 bursts over ~10h. We burned ~2.5% error budget this sprint.

maya: Agree we need both short-term guardrails and medium-term fixes. Dashboard visibility is weak for recurrence.

rebecca: Proposal: (1) add recurrence metric (count of p95 breaches per 24h), (2) tweak alerts to only page on sustained recurrence, (3) owners + ETAs for fixes.

infra-bot: Suggested alert patch:
```
alert: ServiceP95Recurrence
expr: sum(increase(request_latency_p95[24h])) > 0 and increase(request_latency_p95[24h]) / sum(increase(request_count[24h])) > 0.10
for: 1h
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "Sustained p95 recurrence detected"
```
Will reduce noise and focus on repeated breaches.

ishaan: I'll own autoscaler retune (bench + staged rollout). ETA: 2026-04-15. Plan: 2w bench, 1w staging canary, 2w gradual prod.

maya: I'll own KV cache TTL/eviction policy audit and a small experiment to reduce cross-zone evictions. ETA: 2026-04-01.

rebecca: infra action: add recurrence tile + heatmap by zone and wire the alert. ETA: 2026-03-30. Also add an "operational note" on SLO dashboards explaining interim guardrails.

oncall: I'll add a weekly remediation-check calendar for owners and a Runbook link in the alert annotations.

rebecca: Short-term SLO policy: no permanent relaxation. We'll enable guardrails (backpressure for low-priority batches) when recurrence alert fires. If error budget burn >2% next month after fixes, escalate to product for SLA/customer comms.

ishaan: Actions (please ack): - autoscaler retune: ishaan, ETA 2026-04-15 - KV cache audit: maya, ETA 2026-04-01 - recurrence tile + alert: infra-bot, ETA 2026-03-30 - weekly tickler + runbook: oncall, ongoing

maya: ack  posting experiment plan by EOD Monday.

infra-bot: ack  created dashboard PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/dashboards/pulls/99

ishaan: ack  starting bench tests tomorrow.

rebecca: I'll update the postmortem tracker and post a one-line status every Friday here. Ping me if ETAs slip.

oncall: Canary scheduled by ishaan for 3965010000. Notifying rotation.
